question: Who was appointed as the first woman Chair person of the Railway Board by the Government of India on 31 August 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaya Verma Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaya Verma Sinha** was appointed as the first woman Chairperson of the Railway Board by the Government of India on 31 August 2023.
 
• This appointment marks a significant milestone in the history of Indian Railways, showcasing the increasing role of women in leadership positions.
 
• Jaya Verma Sinha has an extensive career in the Indian Railways, having held various key positions and contributed significantly to the sector.
 
• The Railway Board is the apex body of the Indian Railways, responsible for the overall administration, operations, and policy formulation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways** is one of the largest railway networks in the world, operating under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the country's economy, providing transportation for passengers and freight across the nation.
 
• The Railway Board, established in 1905, oversees the functioning of Indian Railways, ensuring its efficient and effective management.
 
• Appointments to the Railway Board are made by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC), which is headed by the Prime Minister of India.
 
• The appointment of Jaya Verma Sinha is seen as a progressive step towards gender equality in traditionally male-dominated sectors like railways.
